scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.format: prettier --write client/src server/src server/test tests README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check client/src server/src server/test tests README.md
